does: Evaluates one compiled stats condition by its index (index -1 is true) against a condition context, through the Lua condition runtime; the common frame of every roll asked by a stats condition: a spell's SpellRoll, a status's RemoveConditions or OnApplyRoll. Arguments: RCX the server's condition machine (EoCServer +0x2C8), RDX the result written back, R8D the condition index, R9 the ls::thoth::shared::ContextData (source +0x0, target +0x10, HitDesc* +0x68, status id +0xD4).

evidence.says: index -1 returns success at once; otherwise looks the index up in the manager (+0x30, +0x98) and runs it through 0xF00130 -> 0xF00720 -> 0xF068F0 into the Lua runtime
the caller chains of Sacred Flame's save, a goblin's weapon attack, HOLD_PERSON's repeat save and See Invisibility's save all pass it at +0xEFFBA1

its callers build an ls::thoth::shared::ContextData on their stack and pass it as the fourth argument (unplaced::EvaluateStatusCondition passes the context from 0x1057860; eoc::spell's roll evaluator 0xFCDD50 passes its own second argument); the index is looked up through RCX +0x30, +0x98

read at the moment of each roll through Ext.Events.Roll with entry and return probes (the frame still open): Sacred Flame's save, Fire Bolt's attack, a goblin's weapon attack and HOLD_PERSON's repeat save each roll inside an open call whose R9 holds the caster or attacker at +0x0 and the target at +0x10; the damage rolls of those hits are not inside it

questions.ask: Its argument list fits ls::thoth::shared::Machine::CheckStaticCondition(int, ContextData&, EnumFlags<EConditionCategory> const&) of the builds with symbols (the result returned through RDX): compare callees with that build to give it the game's name.
